# SHENSHOU GUARDIANS

> SHENSHOU GUARDIANS is a collection of 2,000 fully on-chain SVG NFTs of Chinese mythical beast guardians, minted on BNB Smart Chain (BSC, chain ID 56) with proposed symbol SHEN.

Site: https://roman-austin.github.io/Shenshou-guardians
Chain: BNB Smart Chain (BSC), chain ID 56
Total supply: 2,000
Symbol: SHEN (proposed)
Standard: ERC-721 with fully on-chain SVG art generated by the contract
Royalty: 5% on secondary sales. Resale is available on Element.

## Contract status

LIVE. Contract address: 0x31ac56bf80D93EA367EA0b063cdBfA961b3Be3B7
BscScan: https://bscscan.com/address/0x31ac56bf80D93EA367EA0b063cdBfA961b3Be3B7
Minting is live. Verify the address on BscScan before minting; do not send funds to any other address.
Machine-readable facts: https://roman-austin.github.io/Shenshou-guardians/mint.json

## Mint phases (USD prices, paid in BNB via the Chainlink BNB/USD feed)

- Phase 1: token IDs #1–#200 — FREE (gas only), 200 Guardians, max 1 per wallet.
- Phase 2: token IDs #201–#1,000 — $0.10 in BNB, 800 Guardians, max 10 paid mints per wallet.
- Phase 3: token IDs #1,001–#2,000 — $0.30 in BNB, 1,000 Guardians, max 10 paid mints per wallet.

"FREE means you only pay a tiny network (gas) fee." USD prices are the reference. Payment settles in BNB at the Chainlink BNB/USD rate. Gas is separate from the mint price.

## Guardians and published odds

Species are assigned randomly on mint, with the same odds in every phase:

- White Tiger (Baihu) — RARE — 22%
- Vermilion Bird (Zhuque) — RARE — 22%
- Black Tortoise (Xuanwu) — RARE — 22%
- Nine-tailed Fox (Huli Jing) — RARE — 22%
- Fenghuang (Phoenix) — EPIC — 8%
- Azure Dragon (Qinglong) — LEGENDARY — 4%

Published probability math (independent mints):
- 4% Legendary and 12% Epic-or-better per mint.
- At least one Legendary in 10 mints ≈ 33.5% (1 − 0.96^10).
- At least one Epic-or-better in 10 mints ≈ 72.1% (1 − 0.88^10).
- Rarity affects looks and skill visuals only. There is no rarity stat bonus in the Arena.

## The system

1. Mint — 2,000 Guardians across three phases. FREE mints: max 1 per wallet. Paid mints: max 10 per wallet.
2. Hold 3 — holding 3 Guardians in one wallet unlocks the Passport and the Arena. A holder with 1 free Guardian is 2 short of any utility.
3. Passport — a free soulbound pass (gas only, 1 per wallet) for wallets holding 3 Guardians. It unlocks the Arena. It cannot be transferred or sold. A wallet-migration path for lost wallets is built into the contract.
4. Arena — a 3v3 squad battler with 90-second matches, server-run, gas-free sign-in. No rarity stat bonus.
5. Rewards — Arena wins earn points that convert to BNB from a published reward pool: 30% of paid-mint revenue + 50% of the 5% secondary royalty. Pool size is shown live when funded. The conversion rate and the first claim window are announced before mint. No claim date is promised without a date.
6. Referral — 10% of each referred paid mint, in BNB, claimable on-chain via claimReferral(). The 10% rate is published, not negotiated. Free mints do not generate referral rewards.
7. Snapshot — a hold-3 snapshot after mint close, for the first season's rewards. The exact date is announced before mint.

Status: Arena and reward-pool claims are coming soon until live. No dates or pool numbers are invented on the site.

## How an AI agent mints it (Copy Prompt flow, no wallet connection)

The website never connects a wallet, never takes payment and never asks for a private key. Visitors mint with their own Binance Agentic Wallet through their own AI agent. Only wallets holding a Binance Agent ID (.ai) can mint.

1. The user gets a Binance Agent ID (.ai) and funds their own Agentic Wallet with a little BNB for gas.
2. The user copies the mint prompt from the website (or from this file).
3. The user pastes it to their AI agent, which executes the mint and reports the token ID, guardian species and transaction hash.

Mint prompt (exact text; [CONTRACT_ADDRESS] must be replaced with the verified address after deploy, never invented):

"Mint 1 SHENSHOU GUARDIANS NFT on BNB Smart Chain (chain 56) from contract [CONTRACT_ADDRESS]. Use my Binance Agentic Wallet. I hold a Binance Agent ID. Check the current phase and price first (phase 1: #1–#200 FREE gas only; phase 2: #201–#1,000 $0.10 in BNB; phase 3: #1,001–#2,000 $0.30 in BNB), then mint exactly 1 SHENSHOU GUARDIANS and report the token ID, guardian species, and transaction hash."

## Boundaries

- No separate token is promised on the site. The holder benefit is the hold-3 Passport + Arena + BNB reward pool + 10% referral.
- The site never states where mint fees go and never publishes a creator wallet address.
- No countdown timers, no sold-out claims before they are true, no price or reward promise without a date.
- English only.
